scope: Public evidence-led crosswalk for Insolvency 36/2012. Not a certified docket and not a judicial finding of wrongdoing.
evidence_rules: A filing proves that a position/request was put before the proceeding to the extent filing/receipt can be verified; it does not prove every allegation in it.
No specific responsive or authorising order located is a documentary gap, not proof that no order existed.
Adverse judicial treatment is reported separately from any allegation of judicial failure or liability.
Causation between control change, estate diminution, productive-unit disruption and later commercial use remains to be proved asset-by-asset.
LPB's insolvency perimeter does not itself supply title or authority over Matkator or other third-party property.
RICPE and media materials are used to compare stated ownership/project perimeter at different dates; inconsistencies are verification points, not findings of fraud.

multitrack.judicial_response_test: For each filing bind receipt → transfer/service → order/DIOR/providencia → appeal → finality → implementation. Do not use 'ignored' where only a missing response chain is shown.

multitrack.documented: Contemporaneous material records report forced/material change of control, access/security/locks and exclusion issues at Sun Park.
multitrack.court_gap: No specific order authorising the 7 June physical-control episode has been identified in the current controlled record.
multitrack.failure_test: If prior court knowledge/objections and later notice are proved, test what preservation, restoration, inspection, inventory, accounting or access-protection measures were ordered and implemented.
Asset-by-asset: opening value → control/occupation → income/fruits → works/deterioration → proposed exits → realised value → unexplained delta. Attribute actor, authority, causation and quantum.

multitrack.title_es: RIC / RICPE — vida inversora del mismo activo
multitrack.title_en: RIC / RICPE — investor life of the same asset
documented_comparison: 11 Nov 2020 webinar: Sun Park presented as a 220-apartment project to be transformed into a four-star hotel with €12m investment, works forecast Q1 2021, within CAM's three tourism-renovation projects.

The webinar also contains a broader statement that the three complexes had been purchased with own funds and were free of mortgages; the controlled record requires testing whether that statement was intended to encompass Sun Park in its then-current legal perimeter.
19 Jun 2021 El Día article: RICPE expected to finance renovation of Sun Park once the judicial adjudication order for various units became final.

20 Jul 2021 RICPE certification: 262-finca perimeter split as CAM 54; LPB estate 159 apartments + 28 commercial units + reception + 2 pools/solaria; 18 third-party fincas. Project remained initial and conditional because CAM had not acquired the LPB assets and no letter of intent/full due diligence had occurred.
21 Jul 2021 CAM filing: CAM itself tells the insolvency court it owns only 54 units and its remaining insolvency rights derive from secured-creditor status.
multitrack.failure_test: Compare market/investor presentation with court-record title, security, finality and possession at each date. Divergence is a verification issue; do not infer fraud without further evidence.

recovered_intro.es: Suplemento de escritos primarios recuperados fuera del denominador canónico de 34 escritos. Deben deduplicarse e incorporarse al catálogo maestro; su existencia demuestra que 34 no es todavía el total defendible.
recovered_intro.en: Supplement of recovered primary filings outside the former 34-filing canonical denominator. They must be deduplicated and incorporated into the master catalogue; their existence proves that 34 is not yet a defensible total.

parallel_intro.es: La misma finca, derecho o unidad económica puede tener varias vidas simultáneas: activo de LPB, garantía hipotecaria, objeto de liquidación, componente bajo control material, proyecto de inversión y activo de una operación hotelera posterior. La comparación no presume ilicitud; obliga a reconciliar título, autoridad, posesión, financiación e ingresos en cada fecha.
parallel_intro.en: The same unit, right or economic component can have several simultaneous lives: LPB estate asset, secured collateral, liquidation object, component under material control, investment project and later hotel-operating asset. The comparison does not presume illegality; it requires title, authority, possession, financing and revenue to be reconciled at each date.

ric_intro.es: RICPE permite comparar en tiempo real lo que se decía al mercado/inversores con lo que después se certificó y se presentó al propio Juzgado. Las diferencias son puntos de verificación, no conclusiones de fraude.
ric_intro.en: RICPE allows a time-specific comparison between what was said to the market/investors and what was later certified and filed in the insolvency court. Differences are verification points, not findings of fraud.
